text.title: UI Component Library Basics Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes on whether a second consumer exists, on whether a semantic token set exists to build against, and on whether an external design system already covers the surface — to a full library build, a tokens-first halt, or skip.

decision-tree.root-question: Is there a second consumer — another app, package or team — either shipping now or committed on the roadmap?

conclusion.verdict: skip; ship the components in-app and extract later — with one caller the version-bump ceremony buys nothing

branch.question: Does a semantic design-token set exist as CSS custom properties (or is one being authored before component work starts)?

conclusion.verdict: halt; author the token set first — a library built on literal hex and pixel values cannot be retrofitted onto tokens without touching every file

branch.question: Does an external design system already in the stack (MUI, Mantine, Radix Themes) cover the required primitive surface?

conclusion.verdict: skip primitive authoring; build composition and theming on top of the external system rather than re-authoring its primitives

apply in full: token-only styles, one directory per component with barrel-only exports, `...rest` and `ref` forwarded, a story per variant crossed with state, axe gate on serious/critical, visual baselines on a pinned runner
